description.zh:
集合名。

> 您可以通过[ListCollections](~~2401503~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the collection.

> You can call the [ListCollections](~~2401503~~) operation to query a list of collections.

description.zh:
实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 创建索引的任务ID，由`CreateIndex`接口获得。
description.en: The ID of the index creation job, which is returned from the `CreateIndex` operation.

description.zh:
命名空间。

> 您可以通过[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口创建，通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The namespace name.

>  You can call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation to create a namespace and call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to query a list of namespaces.

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为CreateNamespace接口指定。
description.en:
The password of the namespace.

> The value of this parameter is specified when you call the CreateNamespace operation.

description.zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en:
The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes precedence.

Valid values:

*   ip
*   l2
*   cosine

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb cancel-create-index-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --namespace mynamespace --namespace-password testpassword --collection testcollection --job-id 231460f8-75dc-405e-a669-0c5204887e91 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb CancelCreateIndexJob --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --Collection testcollection --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace --JobId '231460f8-75dc-405e-a669-0c5204887e91'
